description: This file is a JavaScript source code that extends the Summernote WYSIWYG editor with Greek language translations specific to Greece ('el-GR'). It defines localized strings for various UI components of Summernote, such as font styles, image handling, links, videos, tables, and more.

methods.name: Immediately invoked function expression (IIFE)
methods.description: Defines an IIFE that extends jQuery with Greek language translations for Summernote.
